text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Red Desire didn't show up for training
even after the scheduled time, I went looking for her—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Incredible... My hands can't stop turning the pages...! So this is the power of the sacred text, "Offerings to the Saint"...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What a miracle to stumble upon such a rare book at the academy!
This can only be divine providence—
choice_data_list: Hate to ruin your fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Training!
I am terribly sorry, it completely slipped my mind...
